name: Joint leave (cuti bersama)

authority: Law 13/2003 Art. 93(2)(c) and 93(4)(c) — the worker's child is circumcised

authority: Law 13/2003 Art. 93(2)(c) and 93(4)(d) — the worker's child is baptised

authority: Law 13/2003 Art. 93(2)(c) and 93(4)(f) — the worker's spouse, parent, parent-in-law, child or child-in-law dies
